name: frontend-interaction-design-plugin
description: Clarifies product requirements, frontend prototypes, and backend API contracts before producing reviewable interaction models and frontend development plans without generating code.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify requirements before creating frontend design plans.
interface.longDescription: Check a product PRD, frontend prototype, and backend API contract for conflicts, missing rules, and ambiguous behavior before a strict pipeline produces user flows, frontend state models, API sequence diagrams, and an implementation-ready development plan. The clarification gate blocks downstream generation until every consequential question is confirmed. The plugin creates design documents only and never generates or modifies application code.
defaultPrompt: Check this PRD, prototype, and API contract for conflicts before generating the frontend design package.
Clarify every unresolved product, UI, and API decision, then generate the interaction artifacts.
Create the final frontend development plan only after the clarification gate passes.
